name: Loathsome Anglerfish
tooltip:
Loathsome Anglerfish
5 yd range
3.2 sec cast
Description:
"Revolting" is the first word that comes to mind upon seeing this creature. It has as many teeth as there are stars in the sky. And yet, the light it emits is comforting, compelling. It beckons...

Whatever you do, do not follow the lights.

Areas you can find this fish:
- The Coiled Isle
